timing_conventions.frequency: monthly; quarter t <-> months 3t+1..3t+3 (mid-month = centre). Rates and inflation are annualised percent; gaps are percent of potential; z is 100*log real exchange rate vs USD (+ = depreciation of the bloc currency).
timing_conventions.real_rate: rr_m = i_m - mean(pi_{m+1..m+3}); rr12_m = mean(rr_{m..m+11}); mrr_m = 0.10 rr_m + 0.35 rr12_m + 0.35 mean(rr12_m, rr12_{m+12}, rr12_{m+24}) + 0.20 mean(rr12_{m+12j}, j=0..4)  (GPM6 Table 1 weights, steps of 12 months)
timing_conventions.IS: y_m = b1 y_{m-1} + b2 y_{m+1} - b3 mrr_{m-3} + b4 mean(z_{m-2..m-13}) + b5 sum_j s_ij y_{j,m-3} - theta G_m + eps_y, G_m = rho_G G_{m-1} + (1-rho_G) i_us,m-3
timing_conventions.Phillips: pi_m = l1 mean(pi_{m+2..m+13}) + (1-l1) mean(pi_{m-2..m-13}) + l2 y_{m-3} + (l3/4)(zeff_m - zeff_{m-12}) + eps_pi  (pi annualised monthly inflation)
timing_conventions.rule: i_m = g1 i_{m-1} + (1-g1)[(1+g2) mean(pi_{m-1..m+10}) + g4 y_m + k_us i_us,m] + eps_i ; observed rate = max(shadow rate, floor) with the part below the floor passed to mrr at weight psi_ELB
timing_conventions.UIP_closed_form: z_m = rz z_{m-1} - kappa * uip_w * S_m, S_m = sum_{j>=m} (rr_j - rrus_j - eps_rp_j), rz = ((1-phi)/phi)^(1/3), kappa = (1-rz)/(12(2 phi-1))
timing_conventions.potential: Ybar_m = Ybar_{m-1} + g_m/12 + eps_Y ; g_m = tau_m g_ss + (1-tau_m) g_{m-1} + eps_g ; tau_m = 1-(1-tau)^(1/3); neutral real rate: RRbar_m = rho_m RRss + (1-rho_m) RRbar_{m-1} + eps, rho_m = 1-(1-rho)^(1/3)

conversion_rules.lag coefficient + lead coefficient (IS): map both roots of b2 mu^2 - mu + b1 = 0 to the cube root (mu_s^(1/3), mu_u^(1/3)); b2_m = 1/(mu_s_m+mu_u_m); b1_m = b2_m mu_s_m mu_u_m
conversion_rules.forcing coefficients (b3, b4, b5, theta): multiply by (1-b1_m-b2_m)/(1-b1-b2) to keep the long-run multiplier
conversion_rules.delays and windows: x quarters -> 3x months; 4-quarter moving average of lags 1..4 (mean lag 7.5 months) -> 12-month moving average of lags 2..13 (or 3-stage geometric filter with the same mean lag)
conversion_rules.Phillips slopes, inflation lead/lag weig: unchanged (annualised rates and long-run coefficients are period-length invariant)
conversion_rules.UIP: closed form above (not the 1-month UIP: a one-month horizon cannot match both the transient root and the low-frequency gain)
conversion_rules.shock sizes: see shock_sd_monthly_ratios.csv; flows (cost-push) sqrt(3); random-walk levels (eq. real exchange rate, potential level) 1/sqrt(3); persistent stocks by variance matching
